subject.title: Discord: support category-level channel config in guild allowlist

question: Should Discord guild allowlists gain category-level channel configuration, and should that public syntax be a separate categories map or category-prefixed entries inside channels?
rationale: This changes a public Discord config surface and decides which guild messages may reach agents, so automation should not choose the syntax or authorization precedence without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Explicit Categories Map
options.body: Add a Discord guild categories map that reuses channel config, gives direct channel entries precedence, and documents category defaults as an authorization feature.

options.title: Use Category-Prefixed Channel Keys
options.body: Keep one channels map and reserve category:<id> keys, accepting the extra parser and precedence complexity inside the existing allowlist surface.

options.title: Defer To Access Redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open but fold the decision into the broader Discord access-control redesign before adding another dynamic-channel contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Explicit Categories Map
recommendation.body: Add a Discord guild categories map that reuses channel config, gives direct channel entries precedence, and documents category defaults as an authorization feature.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available decision owner from the history because steipete appears in the feature-history commit metadata and related Discord matcher/product routing.
